remaining: Pošta Slovenije full sweep (cash/self-service/POS); evidencna narocila (below-threshold awarded) route; pogodba CSV register; Banka Slovenije annual procurement plan on bsi.si; SDH/state-owned entities; NLB/SID/SKB bank-owned pages; e-identification (eIDAS/EUDI) tenders; check whether JN003263/2026 sorter tender was cancelled.

signals.signal: OPEN TENDER re-issued: 'Preventivno in korektivno vzdrževanje sortirnih sistemov' (preventive + corrective maintenance of banknote sorting systems), notice JN005737/2026-EUe16/01, ref JN-76928, published 17/07/2026. Scope: maintenance of a Giesecke+Devrient BPS M7 MEvo-12SBN banknote sorter with Nota Tracc and LVM modules, plus a standby BPS M7 MEvo-10LSBN, running to 31/08/2032 (6 years). Offer deadline 17/08/2026 10:00, opening 17/08/2026 11:00, questions until 03/08/2026. No estimated value is published in the notice. This re-runs an identical earlier procedure JN003263/2026-EUe16/01 (ref JN-72875, published 27/04/2026, four corrigenda P01-P04, deadline moved to 22/06/2026) which produced no published award.
signals.implies: A live, named 6-year cash-automation maintenance contract at a Eurosystem central bank — squarely Printec managed-services / ATM & cash-automation service (11) and (1). Machines are G+D BPS M7, so G+D is the natural incumbent, but a re-issued procedure after an apparently failed first round is exactly the opening for a multi-vendor service organisation with local field engineers. Printec's 500+ field engineer / 100+ service point network is the differentiator.
signals.likelihood: Deadline 17/08/2026 — decision within weeks; contract runs to 2032
signals.followup: Read the tender documentation on the notice page before 03/08/2026 (question deadline) to see whether OEM authorisation is mandatory; also confirm why JN003263/2026 closed without award.

signals.signal: AWARD: 'Nadgradnja obstoječe programske opreme na dveh sortirnih sistemih BPS M7' — software upgrade of two BPS M7 banknote sorters to M EVO software, removal of a two-stacker module, repositioning of BPS M7 14 and replacement of the shredding module on BPS M7 10. Estimated EUR 356,557.37 excl. VAT; awarded EUR 350,500.00 excl. VAT on a SINGLE bid to Giesecke & Devrient GmbH; contract 2.09.3.1.02-16/2024-11 signed 11/02/2025. [STANDING — dated 2025]
signals.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — award notice JN006991/2024-EUe29/01
signals.implies: Confirms G+D as entrenched incumbent on Banka Slovenije's banknote-processing estate and gives the price anchor for the 2026 maintenance re-tender. Competitor-register input for Agent 6: Giesecke & Devrient GmbH is the Slovenian central-bank cash-processing incumbent.
signals.likelihood: Structural — G+D lock-in persists through the 2032 maintenance contract
signals.followup: Feed G+D Slovenia to the competitor register; watch for a future sorter REPLACEMENT (not maintenance) in Banka Slovenije's annual plan.

signals.entity: Uprava RS za javna plačila (UJP, Public Payments Administration, Ministry of Finance)
signals.signal: AWARD: 'Zagotavljanje opravljanja plačil s plačilnimi karticami za uporabnike sistema spletnih plačil UJP' (card-acquiring for the UJP online-payments system, UJPpay), ref JN 3/2025, notice JN007481/2025-EUe29/01 published 21/01/2026. Estimated EUR 1,031,285 excl. VAT; total awarded value EUR 1,322,730. Four lots by card scheme (Lot 1 Mastercard estimated EUR 678,090, awarded EUR 859,950 on 2 bids, 1 rejected). Winner of Lot 1: Banka Intesa Sanpaolo d.d. Contract C1618-25Y701002 signed 30/12/2025, term 01/01/2026-31/12/2028.
signals.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — award notice JN007481/2025-EUe29/01
signals.implies: The Slovenian state's central e-payments acquiring channel is now locked to a bank until end-2028. Relevant to Printec payments-modernization (4) and POS/acquiring (3) as an ecosystem map rather than a direct bid: the buyer of terminals/processing here is the acquiring bank, not the state. Target the bank, not UJP.
signals.followup: Map Banka Intesa Sanpaolo (Slovenia) terminal/processing supply chain — it now holds both UJP e-payments and several public-pharmacy card-acceptance contracts.

signals.signal: AWARD: 'Najem in vzdrževanje POS terminalov ter zagotavljanje storitve plačevanja obveznih dajatev s plačilnimi karticami preko POS terminalov na negotovinskih plačilnih mestih UJP' (rental + maintenance of POS terminals at UJP cashless payment points), ref JNMV 1/2024-NPM, notice JN008973/2024-SL2/01. Estimated EUR 130,000 excl. VAT; awarded EUR 99,075.80 on 2 bids (runner-up EUR 107,940.60) to NOVA LJUBLJANSKA BANKA d.d. Contract C1618-25Y660003 signed 19/02/2025, term 01/03/2025-31/12/2028. [STANDING — dated 2025]
signals.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — award notice JN008973/2024-SL2/01
signals.implies: Direct Printec POS/terminal-management scope (3), but procured as a bank service rather than a hardware supply — NLB supplies and maintains the terminals. Confirms the Slovenian public sector buys POS as an acquiring service; Printec's route to market is as terminal/TMS supplier to NLB and Intesa Sanpaolo, not as a direct public bidder.
signals.followup: Establish which terminal brand NLB deploys for UJP; approach NLB and Bankart as the terminal-estate owners.

signals.entity: Javno podjetje Ljubljanska parkirišča in tržnice (Ljubljana municipal parking)
signals.signal: AWARD (framework): 'LPT-30/25 Izvajanje storitev sprejemanja plačil parkirnine preko POS terminalov na avtomatskih blagajnah' — card acceptance via POS terminals embedded in automatic parking pay-stations, notice JN000721/2025-EUe29/01. Framework value EUR 600,000 excl. VAT over 48 months (01/04/2025-31/03/2029); single bid, lowest admissible EUR 503,249.48; winner NOVA LJUBLJANSKA BANKA d.d. Framework agreement signed 01/04/2025. [STANDING — dated 2025]
signals.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — award notice JN000721/2025-EUe29/01
signals.implies: Unattended-payment / self-service kiosk payment acceptance (Printec offer 2 and 3 — SmartPay/APS unattended terminals). Slovenian municipal self-service estates are being wired for card payments through banks; a single-bid outcome signals a thin competitive field for unattended POS in Slovenia.
signals.likelihood: Locked to 31/03/2029; comparable municipal estates re-tender continuously
signals.followup: Sweep other Slovenian municipal parking/transport operators for unattended-POS tenders where Printec could supply the terminal to the winning bank.

signals.entity: Javni zavod Lekarna Ljubljana (Ljubljana public pharmacy chain)
signals.signal: AWARD: 'Storitve prejema pologov gotovine' — receipt of daily cash takings (cash deposit services) for the pharmacy chain, 3 years, ref NMV 5/2026, notice JN004067/2026-SL2/01 published 23/06/2026. Estimated EUR 197,000 excl. VAT; awarded EUR 102,028.50 on a SINGLE bid to NOVA LJUBLJANSKA BANKA d.d.; contract 697-64/2026 signed 18/06/2026.
signals.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — award notice JN004067/2026-SL2/01
signals.implies: Retail cash-deposit demand that Printec addresses with smart safes / intelligent deposit and cash-recycling (offer 1) — a cash-in-transit-plus-bank model that smart safes displace. Single bid at roughly half the estimate shows banks pricing aggressively to keep cash handling in-house.
signals.likelihood: 3-year contract from mid-2026; smart-safe displacement pitch is available now to the pharmacy operator
signals.followup: Pitch smart-safe/intelligent-deposit TCO against the NLB deposit fee to Lekarna Ljubljana and comparable Slovenian retail chains.

signals.entity: Obalne lekarne Koper (coastal public pharmacy chain)
signals.signal: AWARD in 3 lots: card acceptance via IP POS terminals (awarded EUR 59,280), night-safe cash deposit (EUR 17,700) and euro banknote-to-coin exchange (EUR 5,880) — notice JN009577/2025-SL2/01 published 12/05/2026, estimate EUR 130,000 excl. VAT, total awarded EUR 82,860. All three lots won on single bids by Banka Intesa Sanpaolo d.d.; contracts 89-13/2026 etc. signed 30/01/2026.
signals.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — award notice JN009577/2025-SL2/01
signals.implies: Confirms the Slovenian public-sector pattern: POS acceptance, night-safe deposit and coin exchange are bundled into a single bank contract. Printec-addressable via the acquiring bank (POS/TMS, offer 3) and via coin/cash recycling equipment sold to the retailer directly (offer 1).
signals.likelihood: Contracts run from 2026; pattern repeats across ~25 Slovenian public pharmacy institutes
signals.followup: Build a list of Slovenian javni zavodi that tender 'bančne storitve' with cash-deposit and coin lots — a repeatable smart-safe / coin-recycler target list.

signals.signal: AWARD: 'JN 25/2025 BAN - nakup naprav za štetje bankovcev in odkrivanje ponarejenih bankovcev' (purchase of banknote-counting and counterfeit-detection devices), notice JN002961/2025-SL2/01. Estimated EUR 7,470 excl. VAT; awarded EUR 7,560 on a single bid to PIGO, trgovina in osebne storitve, d.o.o.; contract C1620-25-000056 signed 22/05/2025. A parallel procedure JN 19/2025 BAN (JN002110/2025-SL2/01, award notice 07/05/2025) received ZERO bids and was not awarded. [STANDING — dated 2025]
signals.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — award notice JN002961/2025-SL2/01
signals.implies: Desktop banknote counter / counterfeit detector demand in the Slovenian state sector, but at micro ticket size, served by a tiny local reseller (PIGO d.o.o.). Competitor-register input for Agent 6: PIGO d.o.o. is the incumbent low-end cash-counting supplier to FURS. A failed zero-bid round shows the state struggles to attract bidders at this size.
signals.followup: Log PIGO d.o.o. as a Slovenian low-end cash-device competitor; check FURS's 2026 equivalent 'BAN' procedures.

signals.signal: AWARD: 'Procesiranje in poravnava SEPA čezmejnih kreditnih plačil' (processing and settlement of SEPA cross-border credit transfers), notice JN001586/2026-SL2/01 published 07/05/2026. Estimated and awarded EUR 100,000 excl. VAT on a single bid to BANKART procesiranje plačilnih instrumentov d.o.o., Ljubljana; contract 2.09.3.1.01-3/2026 signed 30/04/2026.
signals.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — award notice JN001586/2026-SL2/01
signals.implies: Payments modernization (Printec offer 4 — instant payments / SCT Inst / ISO 20022 / payment hubs). Bankart is Slovenia's national card and payments processor and the de-facto gatekeeper for payment-hub and terminal-processing work; it processes even for the central bank. Bankart is the single most important Printec partner-or-competitor node in Slovenia.
signals.likelihood: Structural; Bankart controls Slovenian payment processing
signals.followup: Open a Bankart relationship track (TMS, softPOS, instant-payments/VoP, digital-euro readiness) — it is the aggregation point for Slovenian bank card and POS estates.

signals.signal: OPEN TENDER: 'Vzdrževanje PKI infrastrukture' (maintenance of the central bank's public-key infrastructure), notice JN003548/2026-EUe16/01, ref JN-73319, published 11/05/2026; offer deadline 19/06/2026, opening 19/06/2026 12:00. No estimated value published. Status at 31/07/2026: no award notice published on the portal.
signals.implies: Key management / cryptographic infrastructure — Printec offer 9 (Thales payShield HSM, remote key injection, PCI-PIN) and offer 5 (eIDAS qualified trust / e-signature). Confirms Banka Slovenije runs and outsources its own PKI, a recurring maintenance line to target at the next renewal.
signals.likelihood: Deadline already passed 19/06/2026; award publication imminent
signals.followup: Re-check this notice's dosje for the award and winner in the next run; that name is the PKI incumbent at the Slovenian central bank.

signals.signal: AWARDS in physical/technical security: (a) 'Tehnično varovanje' 3 lots, notice JN000989/2026-EUe29/01 published 02/06/2026, estimate EUR 161,475.40, total awarded EUR 145,432.16 — Lot 1 Technoalarm EUR 60,782.16 to ZARJA ELEKTRONIKA d.o.o., Lot 2 Siemens/Vanderbilt EUR 84,650.00 to A KODA PLUS d.o.o., Lot 3 Honeywell/Morley received zero bids; (b) the failed Lot 3 was re-run as JN002452/2026-EUe29/01, published 18/06/2026, estimate EUR 36,885.24, awarded EUR 40,532.07 on a single bid to SINTAL d.o.o., contract signed 15/06/2026. Separately 'Dobava busola vrat in dograditev biometrije' (mantrap/interlock doors plus biometrics extension, incl. a lot specifically for the cash-operations area 'Gotovinsko poslovanje') was awarded per JN009796/2025-EUe29/01 on 11/03/2026 with no winner name or value published in the notice, and a further round JN002488/2026-EUe16/01 opened 03/04/2026 with offer deadline 29/05/2026.
signals.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — notices JN000989/2026-EUe29/01, JN002452/2026-EUe29/01, JN002488/2026-EUe16/01
signals.implies: Physical ATM/vault security and access control at the central bank (Printec offer 8 — vault locks, anti-skimming, physical security) and biometrics for the cash-handling area (offer 5). Competitor-register input for Agent 6: ZARJA ELEKTRONIKA d.o.o., A KODA PLUS d.o.o. and SINTAL d.o.o. are the Slovenian technical-security incumbents at the central bank. Repeated zero-bid lots show a very thin supplier field.
signals.likelihood: Recurring annual maintenance lots; next round expected 2027
signals.followup: Log the three security firms as Slovenian competitors/partners; retrieve the busola-vrata award winner, which is the biometrics integrator inside the cash-operations area.

signals.signal: AWARD: upgrades, maintenance and technical support for SISBON (the Slovenian retail credit-information/credit-register system), notice JN009309/2025-EUe29/01 published 10/03/2026. Estimated EUR 479,360 excl. VAT; awarded EUR 479,850 on a single bid to ADACTA programska oprema d.o.o., Ljubljana; contract 2.09.3.1.02-16/2025 signed 27/02/2026.
signals.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — award notice JN009309/2025-EUe29/01
signals.implies: Adjacent core-banking / regulatory-data programme (Printec offer 12 and 7 — compliance and operational resilience). Adacta is the Slovenian software house holding the central bank's credit-register platform — a partner-or-competitor for Printec compliance and digital-channel work in Slovenia.
signals.followup: Assess Adacta d.o.o. as a Slovenian systems-integrator partner for Printec compliance/AML and digital-channel offers.
